parameter_summary: After the implementation PR actually merges, publish one ledger-only closeout branch and PR to record TASK-0047's actual merge and close result as the mechanical completion of this same authorized delivery.
conditions: This is limited to the mechanical audit closeout of this delivery, with no new implementation or broader external authority.
The implementation PR merged into main after exact-head required CI success; its tested head and subject are ancestors of the actual merge commit.
CLI close recorded the actual implementation merge; preserve all historical events, approvals and evidence.
Compared with updated main, every change is within .ai/tasks/TASK-0047 and only publishes task state, appended events, delivery notes and closeout PR description.
The worktree is clean and no unrelated remote work is overwritten; no force push, deletion, deployment, tag, release or protection change.
